_comment: Prompts for the built-in sounds generated with ElevenLabs Sound Effects (tools/elevenlabs-sounds.py). Lengths follow how each event plays (docs/adr/0015, design §4): lid_overbent is the continuous opening sound (30-120 degrees, pauses and resumes), lid_opened plays once on wake, lid_closing once before sleep, slaps must stay short so the next slap isn't dropped.

defaults.style: close-up, dry, no music, no voice-over, no long reverb

kept_sounds.what: ElevenLabs Sound Effects: a sharp crack of glass (first 0.5 s, with a 50 ms fade-out)
ElevenLabs Sound Effects: slow, high-tension glass straining, cracking and shattering
ElevenLabs Sound Effects: slow, high-tension glass straining, cracking and shattering
ElevenLabs Sound Effects: slow, high-tension glass straining, cracking and shattering

profiles.desc_zh: 整台都是玻璃：慢慢裂開、清脆碎掉。
profiles.desc_en: Made of glass: it cracks slowly and shatters crisply.

sounds.prompt: A bright crystal glass ring swelling up with a delicate high chime and a tiny crackle, like a glass panel waking up
A single firm knuckle knock on a thick glass window, one crisp, bright and clearly audible 'tink'
A metal spoon tapping a drinking glass once, one bright clear ring 'ting', short
A sharp hit on a glass pane that cracks it with a quick splintering sound, no shattering
A thick sheet of glass struck and cracking with a sharp creak and a few tiny splinters, it does not break
A hard punch shattering a glass pane: instant impact, dense shattering, a few shards falling, short tail
A glass bottle smashed against a hard surface, sudden burst of breaking glass with short scattering shards
A large glass window shattering: a sudden crash, then a short shower of glass shards falling on a hard floor, all over within two seconds, clean recording without distortion

profiles.desc_zh: 開蓋像推開地城石門，砂石落下，機關啟動。
profiles.desc_en: Opening the lid grinds open a dungeon gate; grit falls and traps spring.

sounds.prompt: A massive ancient stone door slowly grinding open, continuous dry stone-on-stone scraping with small grit and pebbles trickling, steady pressure, no impact at the end
A heavy stone slab being dragged slowly across a stone floor, continuous rough grinding with irregular little stutters and dust falling, no impact at the end
A heavy stone block shifting with a short deep rumble and a puff of falling dust in a dungeon
A stone door sliding shut quickly: a brief stone-on-stone grind that ends in one solid, heavy stop, very short, no echo
A single knuckle knock on a solid stone wall, one short dull click
A small pebble tapping once on a stone floor, short dry tick
A fist hitting a stone door, one solid thump with a little crumbling grit
A wooden club hitting a stone pillar, one hard knock with a few small stones falling
A battering ram hitting a stone gate: deep impact, rocks cracking and debris falling briefly
A large rock smashed by a sledgehammer, heavy crack and chunks of stone scattering, short tail
A dungeon trap mechanism triggering: stone gears clunking, chains rattling and a heavy stone block dropping

parked_profiles.desc_zh: 開蓋就是機甲啟動：渦輪升速、單眼亮起，拍太多次就紅色警報。
parked_profiles.desc_en: Opening the lid launches a giant robot: turbines spin up, the eye lights up, and too many slaps trigger red alert.

sounds.prompt: A giant anime mecha powering up: a jet turbine spinning up with a rising high-pitched whine, hydraulic hisses and rhythmic servo clunks, energy building, 1990s anime sci-fi sound design
A giant robot reactor charging: a rising electric whir climbing steadily in pitch, mechanical locks releasing one after another and steam vents hissing, anime sci-fi
A giant robot's single eye lighting up with a sharp electronic 'ping' and a short rising hum, anime mecha
A cockpit hatch sealing shut with a short pneumatic hiss and a heavy metallic clunk
A short sci-fi cockpit interface beep, mecha control panel
A single light metallic tap on giant robot armour with a faint electronic blip
A giant robot getting hit: a heavy metal clang with a short damage alert beep
An armour plate impact with a short energy shield crackle, sci-fi
A giant robot taking a heavy hit: explosive metal impact, electric sparks and a short alarm blip
A beam weapon blast hitting armour: a zap, crackling sparks and a metal groan, sci-fi
A mecha cockpit red alert: an urgent repeating warning klaxon with sparks and a flickering power drop, anime sci-fi

parked_profiles.desc_zh: 把筆電變成紅白機：開蓋集氣、拍打就是受傷音，連擊直接 Game Over。
parked_profiles.desc_en: Your laptop as an 8-bit console: opening charges up, slaps are damage blips, and a combo means game over.

sounds.prompt: An 8-bit NES-style chiptune power-up: a square-wave pitch sweep slowly rising over five seconds with a fast arpeggio shimmer, retro video game
A retro 8-bit video game charging attack: a buzzing square wave rising steadily in pitch with a pulsing tremolo, building up, chiptune
A short original retro arcade 'insert coin' start jingle, 8-bit chiptune
A short 8-bit video game pause sound: two quick descending square-wave blips
A short 8-bit video game jump sound, one rising square-wave blip
A tiny 8-bit menu select blip, very short
An 8-bit video game hit sound: a short noisy crunch with a falling pitch
A retro video game player damage sound: a quick descending square-wave
An 8-bit video game explosion: a crunchy white noise burst decaying quickly
A retro arcade enemy destroyed sound: a noisy blast with a falling tone, chiptune
A short original 8-bit game over jingle: a sad descending chiptune melody

_parked: parked_profiles are designed and were generated once (2026-10-25) but are not built in yet; the tool ignores them. Move one into profiles to bring it back.
